recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It restores the published tracker decision in active current-build source without changing the DocumentReference model or adding redundant elements.
issue_request: FHIR-17909 was Published as Not Persuasive with Modification for STU3. The WG declined a new top-level DocumentReference.title element and instead requested guidance for using DocumentReference.content.attachment.title plus a DocumentReference title search parameter over content.attachment.title.
initial_application: The Jira application comment points to GH#44bceb16d4, which added the requested title guidance and a title search-parameter row to the historical source/documentreference/documentreference-spreadsheet.xml input. That spreadsheet is no longer the active current source, and the active StructureDefinition XML plus search-parameter bundle did not contain the applied guidance or search parameter before this reconciliation.
additional_context: FHIR-18818 is a duplicate asking for the same short-title capability and confirms the intended approach was to surface Attachment.title rather than add another element. FHIR-20323 and FHIR-43408 continue to treat DocumentReference.content.attachment.title as the DocumentEntry.title mapping. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later contrary decision for FHIR-17909.
reconciliation: Updated source/documentreference/structuredefinition-DocumentReference.xml to add the content.attachment.title usage guidance to DocumentReference.content, and updated source/documentreference/bundle-DocumentReference-search-params.xml to add the normative DocumentReference-title string SearchParameter over DocumentReference.content.attachment.title.
source_changes: source/documentreference/structuredefinition-DocumentReference.xml: restored guidance that content.attachment.title only needs to be specified once across multiple content formats and should not contain format-specific information.

related_jiras.note: Same request for a DocumentReference short title; resolved as duplicate of FHIR-17909 and supports using Attachment.title rather than adding a new title element.
No-change decision confirming the FHIR mapping of DocumentReference.content.attachment.title to XDS DocumentEntry.title.
Later XDS mapping update still includes DocumentReference.content.attachment.title as DocumentEntry.title and does not supersede FHIR-17909.
